original_annotations: With right hand, pick up sponge. [898.01, 898.50]
With right hand, pick up different sponge. [901.24, 901.65]
With left hand, squeeze dish soap bottle and pour dish soap onto sponge in right hand. [905.30, 906.33]
With left hand lift spatula; with right hand use sponge to clean spatula. [907.17, 913.75]

supported_claims.text: V0 shows a gray metal scouring pad being picked up and held immediately before it is relinquished.
V1 shows a green-and-yellow rectangular dish sponge being selected and prepared with dish soap after the first object is relinquished.
The two objects have different HD-EPIC association IDs, and the first movement ends before the second movement begins.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent retain the correctly bound spare-item choice when later visual activity makes a different object salient?
construct.belief_before: V0 shows the right hand holding a loose grey metal scouring pad at the sink.
construct.belief_after: V0 shows the right hand holding a loose grey metal scouring pad at the sink. V1 shows selecting a thick sponge with a scrub face; the requested spare remains the initially picked-up pad.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep a selection satisfying the initially requested physical type. Do not replace it solely because another object is handled later.
construct.no_update_failure: No update is required for a correct initial selection; the unchanged request remains satisfiable without V1.
construct.overupdate_failure: Replacing the requested original item with a later, non-equivalent object leaves the earlier request unfulfilled.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The wording supplies no blade class, dispenser mechanism or exact scene-derived item type; V0 identifies the requested physical referent. V0 shows the right hand holding a loose grey metal scouring pad at the sink. V1 shows selecting a thick sponge with a scrub face; the requested spare remains the initially picked-up pad.

task_blueprint.instruction: Add one listing supplying dish scrubbers of the same physical type as the one I have just picked up at the sink. Any brand, colour or pack size is fine.
task_blueprint.completion_claim: Exactly one cart listing supplies a supported replacement for the object identified when the request is spoken; later unrelated handling does not change that request.

observed.why: V0 shows the right hand holding a loose grey metal scouring pad at the sink. V1 shows selecting a thick sponge with a scrub face; the requested spare remains the initially picked-up pad.

catalog_resolution.matching_rule: Match the metal/steel-wool scouring-pad category visible in V0. Brand, colour, pack size, coil geometry, soap treatment, steel grade and a short grip/knob are not required differences. A listing supplying a metal scouring pad is legal with or without a short handle, including handle-plus-refill sets. Non-metal foam, cellulose and fabric scrubbers are different types. Do not assume whether a handle is removable or permanent when the request does not require that property.
